scope: F07 only: retrospective reliability analysis on frozen E1/E3; no RL or new environment evaluation
case_split: Within each suite/task, sort the 100 outcome cases by SHA256('F07-v1|'+suite+'|'+task+'|'+initial_state_hash). First 50 are diagnostic development pool D; last 50 are held-out scoring pool O. Same split across all policies/horizons/seeds. No success or return used in the split. These remain previously seen research data, not a new blind experiment.
subset_sampling: without replacement from D; paired across tasks' policy comparisons and nested across sample sizes; independent per task; common draws across contexts in a suite
tie_priority: Uniform, then the suite's task order; track exact ties
development_fixed: Choose allocation by mean 40k macro on D only from the other two original seeds, same suite/checkpoint, all three continuations. Exclude held-out original seed entirely; no O outcomes used.

mode_definitions.measurement_only_20: Select with two continuations at 20k, score the same two continuations at 20k on O: finite-case selection uncertainty.
mode_definitions.cross_repeat_20: Same selector as measurement_only_20, score the third continuation at 20k on O.
mode_definitions.cross_repeat_20_to_40: Same selector as measurement_only_20, score the third continuation at 40k on O. Primary retrospective transfer target.
mode_definitions.cross_repeat_40: Select with two continuations at 40k, score the third at 40k on O. Expensive diagnostic reference, unavailable at 20k.
mode_definitions.same_trajectory_20_to_40: Select using one continuation at 20k, score that continuation at 40k on O. Retrospective same-trajectory sensitivity.

reliability_rule.paired_difference_support: For k diagnostic continuations, support is -1,-1+1/k,...,1 with equal prior mass, applied separately by task. Average continuations within each matched case before counting; do not count them as independent evaluation cases.
reliability_rule.rule: Switch from the fallback only if raw macro gap >=2pp, the paired regularized posterior mean minus z times posterior SD is positive, and the chosen allocation beats fallback in every diagnostic continuation. Otherwise retain fallback.
reliability_rule.meaning: Predeclared heuristic, not a calibrated confidence interval or future-success probability. Prior prevents zero uncertainty in all-zero/all-one samples; repeated learning uncertainty is only screened by agreement.
reliability_rule.gap_only_control: Same fallback and 2pp raw gap threshold, without uncertainty/agreement terms.

aggregation: Report A200,A400,B200,C200 separately. Pooled result gives A/B/C equal weight; within A average its two checkpoints; then equal original-seed weight. Monte Carlo draws are not independent training repetitions.
uncertainty: Report all three original-seed values and their range, without claiming a well-estimated population interval from three seeds. Conditional paired case bootstrap fixes trained policies and resamples cases jointly across all policies, continuations and horizons within task. Pointwise intervals are descriptive; additionally show per-context simultaneous max-standardized bands across 20 horizon/pair contrasts. No global familywise claim across all contexts. Zero empirical case variance does not imply zero population uncertainty.
horizon_reversal: Opposite strict signs for an allocation pair's mean 20k vs 40k difference; >=2pp magnitude at both horizons is secondary. Conditional robust reversal requires opposite-sign intervals excluding zero. Confirm variability across individual continuations separately.
variance_comparison: Compare observed continuation SD of paired macro differences on the fixed 100-case bank to RMS conditional case SE for a single continuation. This is not an additive causal variance decomposition.
costs: New environment and learner steps are zero. Record actual CPU/wall time, source and input hashes, package versions and failures. Record simulated diagnostic evaluation cost using observed episode lengths and all diagnostic policy evaluations; 20k/40k all-allocation probes remain costly offline references. Do not fabricate equal-budget net gains from full-40k outcomes.
forbidden_claims: conditional case bootstrap is uncertainty over new pretrained seeds
initial_inspection_notes: Two guessed marker names did not exist during schema discovery; actual discovered IDs use E1_A_bank and *_e20. No experiment files changed.
